# muxx

muxx is [mox](https://github.com/mjl-/mox), the modern full-featured mail
server by Mechiel Lukkien, with additional features. Every muxx feature is off
unless configured: without configuration, muxx behaves exactly like mox.

- What muxx is, how it relates to mox, its versions and images:
  [MUXX.md](https://github.com/dwlfrth/muxx/blob/main/MUXX.md)
- Its features, each with the release that added it:
  [MUXX.md#features](https://github.com/dwlfrth/muxx/blob/main/MUXX.md#features)
- Everything else, from installation to configuration, is mox's:
  [README.md](https://github.com/dwlfrth/muxx/blob/main/README.md)
- License: mox is MIT
  ([LICENSE.MIT](https://github.com/dwlfrth/muxx/blob/main/LICENSE.MIT)), and
  muxx's changes are under the same license
  ([LICENSE.muxx](https://github.com/dwlfrth/muxx/blob/main/LICENSE.muxx))
